1512 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and also by 400 since it's a century year in the Gregorian calendar? Actually, 1512 is before 1582, but we are told to use Gregorian calendar arithmetic, so we treat it as proleptic Gregorian).  
Leap year: yes.  

Start: 1512-01-19.  
Subtract 89 days:  
First subtract 19 days to reach 1512-01-01.  
Remaining days: 89 - 19 = 70 days.  
Subtract 70 days from 1512-01-01:  
Go to 1511-12-31 and back further:  
December has 31 days, so 1511-12-01 is 31 days before 1512-01-01.  
70 - 31 = 39 days left.  
November has 30 days, so 1511-11-01 is 30 days before 1511-12-01.  
39 - 30 = 9 days left.  
Subtract 9 more days from 1511-11-01:  
1511-10-31 (1 day back), 1511-10-30 (2), ..., 1511-10-23 is 9 days back.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1511-10-23
